# CCMAF Skills — Personal Assistant (`ccmaf-skills-assistant`)

A personal assistant that proposes and never acts unasked: an Obsidian-compatible knowledge vault, inbox triage, calendar help, a morning briefing, a commitments ledger, and care with personal data.

**Audience:** Anyone using Claude as a personal assistant over notes, mail and calendar.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-assistant@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.

## Skills (6)

| Skill | What it covers | Reference docs |
|---|---|---|
| [`calendar-assistant`](skills/calendar-assistant/SKILL.md) | Calendar via connectors: free slots across time zones, clashes, travel time, prep notes, reminders. Proposes; the user confirms. | 7 |
| [`commitments-tracker`](skills/commitments-tracker/SKILL.md) | Ledger of who promised what to whom by when, kept in the vault: owner-confirmed capture, drafted nudges (never sent), weekly review. | 5 |
| [`daily-briefing`](skills/daily-briefing/SKILL.md) | Morning briefing from vault, mail, calendar and commitments: today, waiting on you, safe to ignore; phone-first, read-only. | 5 |
| [`inbox-triage`](skills/inbox-triage/SKILL.md) | Triage mail via Claude connectors: sort, summarise threads, extract tasks/promises, draft replies, flag phishing. Never sends unasked. | 7 |
| [`knowledge-vault`](skills/knowledge-vault/SKILL.md) | Obsidian-compatible markdown vault: folders, daily notes, templates, inbox processing, linking, git sync and conflicts across PC and phone. | 7 |
| [`personal-data-care`](skills/personal-data-care/SKILL.md) | What never to store (secrets, card/ID numbers, health unless asked), redaction, leak response, local-only data, GDPR-minded habits (EU/IE). | 6 |
